text: Unresolved holds are concentrated in the Bursar's office, which accounts for 24 of 28 unresolved holds [M5]. The remaining holds sit with the Registrar (2), the Library (1), and Student Life (1) [M5]. Notably, 18 students have an unresolved financial hold under $1,000—a small balance standing between them and enrollment [M3]. Outreach focused on the Bursar's low-balance cases could clear the largest share of these barriers quickly [M3][M5].
